gapRegister.description: Potential for creating a shadow configuration core or database parallel to SECP core.
gapRegister.resolution: Enforced strict subordination of ConfigurationRegistry. All revision matching, model binding, and digital thread tracking route through canonical SECP core modules.

gapRegister.description: Risk of AI executing sign-offs, bypasses, or overriding configuration compatibility rules.
gapRegister.resolution: Implemented assertHumanGovernanceAuthority at backend boundaries, throwing AI_GOVERNANCE_VIOLATION upon unauthorized AI operations.

gapRegister.description: Risk of silent, untracked changes to approved configurations after a baseline release.
gapRegister.resolution: Sealed baselines cryptographically with an evidence root hash. verifyBaselineImmutability throws BASELINE_IMMUTABILITY_VIOLATION on direct modifications.

gapRegister.description: Manually declared configuration statuses masking underlying engineering matrix mismatches.
gapRegister.resolution: Implemented ConfigurationCompatibilityEngine. Calculates validity dynamically by evaluating revision compatibility, interface compliance, and option selections.

gapRegister.description: Risk of configuration upgrades decoupling from physical safety claims or controls.
gapRegister.resolution: Linked P13 and P12 Safety Engine. handleItemInvalidation automatically cascades configuration changes to invalidate matching safety claims, forcing them into REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED status.
